task.payload: {"metadata":{"description":"Image previews for DSH sessions: read_image, user/assistant/Markdown/present images, a full-size lightbox with zoom, rotate, pan, download, sidebar and native file actions.","id":"gh:1347992650","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-image-preview","slug":"algerkong/dsh-image-preview","topics":["deepseek-harness","deepseek-harness-plugin","deepseek-harness-plugin-dev","deepseek-harness-plugins","dsh","dsh-plugin","dsh-plugins"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Image previews for DSH sessions: read_image, user/assistant/Markdown/present images, a full-size lig"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"htbox with zoom, rotate, pan, download, sidebar and native file actions."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-image-preview"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"> 中文版"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"**Image preview for the dsh session interface.** dsh 0.2.x already renders `read_image` as a collaps"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"ed image card and assistant final-output images as an official gallery. This plugin takes over all o"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"f them: `read_image` rows get a **thumbnail visible by default**, and images the user sends, plus im"},{"id":"p4s4","text":"ages in the assistant's final answer — including image files in `present` delivery cards — use the s"},{"id":"p4s5","text":"ame **full-size lightbox** with cross-image navigation, zoom, rotate, pan, download, and file action"},{"id":"p4s6","text":"s (open with default/associated app, open in sidebar, reveal in folder)."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"| 🖼️ **Visible thumbnail** | `read_image` results render as a rounded ~240px thumbnail instead of a "},{"id":"p6s2","text":"collapsed card, so the image is visible without expanding the row | | 🔍 **Click for full size** | Cl"},{"id":"p6s3","text":"ick the thumbnail to open the original image in a lightbox — dismiss with `Esc`, clicking the backdr"},{"id":"p6s4","text":"op, or the close button; focus is restored to the trigger on close | | ↔️ **Cross-row navigation** |"},{"id":"p6s5","text":" Arrow buttons / ← → keys cycle through **every image loaded in the session** (counter shows `3 / 4`"},{"id":"p6s6","text":") — dsh's built-in lightbox only ever shows a single image | | 🔎 **Zoom, rotate, pan** | Toolbar wit"},{"id":"p6s7","text":"h zoom out / zoom in / rotate left / rotate right / download. Scroll wheel zooms, drag pans while ma"},{"id":"p6s8","text":"gnified, and `+` `-` `0` `,` `.` are keyboard shortcuts. Zoom is clamped to 25%–800% and resets when"},{"id":"p6s9","text":" you switch images | | ⬇️ **Download** | Saves the original bytes under the attachment's own filenam"},{"id":"p6s10","text":"e through a same-origin `` (works with the `blob:` URLs the host loader returns) | | 🔐 *"},{"id":"p6s11","text":"*Uses the host's image pipeline** | Image bytes are resolved through the session-authorized `loadIma"},{"id":"p6s12","text":"ge` loader dsh injects into the slot owner — no hand-rolled attachment RPC | | 🧾 **Final-output imag"},{"id":"p6s13","text":"es** | Assistant image blocks (`conversation.chat.message.images`) and Markdown images in the final "},{"id":"p6s14","text":"answer open the plugin lightbox too | | 👤 **User-sent images** | Images in the user's own message (`"},{"id":"p6s15","text":"conversation.chat.user.images`) are taken over too and open the plugin lightbox | | 📂 **Presented im"},{"id":"p6s16","text":"age cards** | Image files in `present` delivery cards (e.g. `preview_hero.png`) open the plugin ligh"},{"id":"p6s17","text":"tbox directly instead of the sidebar first; STL / Markdown cards keep the official preview | | 🧩 **0"},{"id":"p6s18","text":".2.x-aware** | Shadows only the row renderer; the official `tool.call.images` child slot stays decla"},{"id":"p6s19","text":"red and untouched | | ⏱️ **Complete states** | Running (`row.running`), failed with retry (`image.lo"},{"id":"p6s20","text":"adFailed`), and loading (`image.loading`) states are all covered | | 🌗 **Theme aware** | All colors "},{"id":"p6s21","text":"reference dsh theme tokens (`--dsw-*`), so the preview follows the light/dark theme automatically |"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"### Lightbox controls"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"| Action | Control | Shortcut |"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"| Zoom in / out | toolbar `+` / `−`, or scroll wheel | `+` / `-` | [该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"## Compatibility"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"Built and verified against **dsh `0.2.1-rc.2`**. The browser contract is unchanged from `0.1.5-rc.2`"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"; the plugin is still a pure client bundle with no host-side behavior. The manifest declares `engine"},{"id":"p11s3","text":"s.dsh: >=0.1.5-rc.2 <0.3.0-0` so dsh can reject it outside that range."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"**What changed in dsh 0.2.x.** dsh now ships its own `read_image` toolview, image card, and `tool.ca"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"ll.images` child slot filled by the official `MessageImages` gallery. The official row is **collapse"},{"id":"p12s3","text":"d by default**, and its lightbox shows one image at a time. This plugin still shadows the whole row "},{"id":"p12s4","text":"so thumbnails stay visible, and keeps the extra lightbox features. It deliberately does **not** decl"},{"id":"p12s5","text":"are `tool.call.images` as a child: the official entry already declares that slot, and a second decla"},{"id":"p12s6","text":"ration would throw `slot ... is already declared`."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"Image positions include the user message slot `conversation.chat.user.images` (official `MessageImag"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"es` at priority 100, shadowed at -1) and the assistant final-output paths. Assistant image blocks go"},{"id":"p13s3","text":" through the `conversation.chat.message.images` single slot, which this plugin shadows at `priority:"},{"id":"p13s4","text":" -1` (the official `MessageImages` uses `priority: 100`). Markdown images (`!alt`) are rendered by a"},{"id":"p13s5","text":" private button/lightbox inside `MarkdownText`, not a slot, so the plugin intercepts clicks in the c"},{"id":"p13s6","text":"apture phase and opens its own lightbox. `present` delivery cards are not a slot either: the whole-c"},{"id":"p13s7","text":"ard preview button's `title` is the Host absolute path, and the plugin intercepts only image extensi"},{"id":"p13s8","text":"ons; STL / Markdown cards still open the official sidebar preview. If the host does not expose a Rea"},{"id":"p13s9","text":"ctDOM render root, all interception backs off and leaves the official behavior intact."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"`read_image` submits **PNG / JPEG / WebP / GIF** only, so those are the formats the plugin can displ"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"ay; earlier claims about SVG / BMP / ICO were incorrect."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"> **Why the low priority matters.** `tool.call.toolview` is a **keyed** slot, and its registry rejec"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"ts a second registration for the same key at the same priority: > [代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"> [该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"`dsh-image-preview` is a **pure client-side plugin**. It registers a keyed slot on `tool.call.toolvi"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"ew` with key `read_image` at `priority: -1` and takes over rendering of the `read_image` tool row:"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"- `sessionId` and `t` are injected by the session-scoped slot's standard kit (`dsh-client-ui-session"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"` / the locale seat). - `loadImage` is the session-authorized loader dsh passes in the slot owner pr"},{"id":"p20s3","text":"ops (`MessageImageLoader`, i.e. `uiConversation.imageUrl(sessionId, attachment)`, cached per session"},{"id":"p20s4","text":"). The plugin never touches `/api/session.attachment` directly. - Attachment metadata (`attachmentId"},{"id":"p20s5","text":"`, `mediaType`, `width`, `height`) comes straight from the tool result block. - The lightbox looks l"},{"id":"p20s6","text":"ike dsh's built-in `ImageLightbox` (portal to `body`, backdrop mask, ESC/backdrop/close dismissal, f"},{"id":"p20s7","text":"ocus restore) but adds cross-image navigation plus zoom / rotate / pan / download. - Zoom and rotati"},{"id":"p20s8","text":"on are a single CSS `transform` on the `` (no re-encoding); downloads hand the loader's `blob:`"},{"id":"p20s9","text":" URL straight to ``, so no bytes are copied or re-fetched. - The image registry is bucke"},{"id":"p20s10","text":"ted by `sessionId`, so two sessions open at once never cross-navigate into each other's images."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"Final-output images:"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"}],"truncated":true}
